277123755.description:
Product Overview:
This lot features a variety of polished and raw semi-precious gemstone specimens. Included are agate slices with gold-toned edges in shades of gray, brown, and green, some showing banding and crystalline structures. Also present are colorful tumbled stones in multiple hues, a carved stone star, and a small bag of additional tumbled stones. The collection includes Brazilian-made agate coasters that are not food safe.

Specifications:
- Agate slices with gold-toned edges
- Various shades: gray, brown, green
- Banding and crystalline formations visible on some slices
- Colorful tumbled stones in purple, blue, green, pink, and clear
- Carved stone star included
- Small bag of additional tumbled stones
- Agate coasters from Brazil (not food safe)
- Mixed polished and raw mineral specimens
